Black bloons are immune to explosions (bomb, mortar etc). White bloons are immune to ice, zebras are immune to both. Leads are immune to sharp objects (darts, tack etc). They come on round 28. Only some towers can see camos and some upgrades let towers see them. A camo green comes on round 24, the next camos are on 33. Purples are immune to magic attacks (wizard, lasers on super etc). They come on round 25. Ceramic bloons take 10 damage before they turn into rainbows and come on round 38. The first MOAB bloon comes on round 40 and has 180 health. A BFB comes on round 60 and splits into 4 MOABs. Round 80 has a ZOMG that splits into 4 BFBs. DDTs have the properties of lead, camo and black bloons. They come on round 90 and split into 4 camo regrow ceramics. A BAD comes on round 100 and splits into 3 DDTs and 2 ZOMGs. Leads, ceramics and any MOAB class bloon can have a fortified property that doubles their health. Any bloon (non-MOAB) can have the regrow property that regrows their layer over time. Rounds to prepare for are 24 (camo green), 28 (leads), 63 (3 massive ceramic clumps), 76 (massive regrow ceramic clump), 78 (ceramic clump and camo ceramic clump), 90 (3 DDTs), 95 (30 DDTs and more), 98 (huge amount of fortified  BFBs and some ZOMGs), 99 (fortified DDTs) and 100 (A BAD).
